about_the_game:
Driver Rookie: License Quest is a realistic driving simulation game designed to help players experience what it’s like to drive on UK roads and prepare for the driving test.
Whether you are a beginner or an immigrant adapting to left-hand traffic, this game provides the perfect practice environment with realistic vehicle physics and authentic traffic rules.

The game offers three distinct modes:

  • Free Drive – Explore the city map, practice driving at your own pace, and get familiar with UK traffic flow.

  • Practice Mode – Short and focused driving lessons designed to teach specific maneuvers such as roundabouts, parking, or turning.

  • Mock Test – A full 35–40 minute driving test session that simulates the real UK practical exam, complete with evaluation criteria.

Key Features

  • Authentic UK traffic rules including roundabouts, speed limits, and “Show Me, Tell Me” style challenges

  • Realistic vehicle physics powered by the Chaos Vehicle system

  • Three gameplay modes: Free Drive, Practice, and Mock Test

  • Navigation voice guidance with optional captions

  • Steam Cloud support for saving progress

  • Controller support (gamepads and steering wheels planned)

With Driver Rookie: License Quest, you can build confidence behind the wheel before facing the real exam.
Master UK roads, avoid common mistakes, and take the first step toward becoming a licensed driver!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
